final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.throws IS NULL OR trim(p.throws) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.throws END AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.throws IS NULL OR trim(p.throws) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.throws END), shares AS (SELECT hand, player_count, CAST(player_count AS REAL) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, COUNT(*) OVER () AS hand_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - 1.0 / hand_count) AS average_excess_share FROM shares WHERE share > 1.0 / hand_count
